findings.text: Homepage LCP measured at 7.2s on mobile 3G-Fast on 3 October.

output.opener: Hi Adaeze, your homepage took 7.2 seconds to show its main content on mobile in our test on 3 October [[f:audit3xyz2024webpagespeed01a]]. On Nigerian mobile data that pushes visitors to bounce before they see what you do — a couple of targeted fixes usually recover most of it.
